notes.title: ▼2016/08/02 Update v1.0.6
notes.notes:
・Added Mouse & Keyboard control type 
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22556326/2bd259f52da95c36c5b2feaf7640cdf038acdd7c.jpg
*The full size guide can be found in the store page, under "View the quick reference".

Players can access this control type by Left-clicking at the title screen, with the "PUSH START" display. 
Do note that if you proceed via a controller button, the game will recognise it as a controller type input, and likewise a keyboard button will register as a pure Keyboard only (no mouse) control type. 

For Keyboard&Mouse control configuration type, depending on the different sequence of the game, the "Confirm" button may either be Left Click, the Enter key or the Space key. Also, the Enter key is used to mark yourself as Ready for online game modes. Press the Backspace key to exit the player room.


・Allow stages to be selectable in online mode 
Previously players can only choose the weather conditions, but now players can choose both the Stage and the Weather separately.

notes.title: 2016/06/17 Additional notes on v1.0.5 update
notes.notes:
We would like to apologize for the lack of elaboration on certain elements newly introduced to the game yesterday. The details are as follows:

 ・Network Indicator (aka Antenna) will now be displayed in the search results.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22556326/94f4e843bb41f43a59017aab345b965b66b8ce5d.png
With regards to the above new introduction, we have implemented 2 new displays for the search result.

RTT: Stands for "Round Trip Time", where it measures the time taken for data to travel to and fro between 2 players. The number is represented in milliseconds. This term is also commonly known as the "ping".

CQ: Stands for "Connection Quality", where it displays the stability of the connection between 2 players.

notes.title: ▼2016/06/16 Update v1.0.5
notes.notes:
・Added Replay Viewer function.
 　You can automatically save your Exhibition and Online matches by setting AutoSave to "ON", found under OPTION→ReplayConfig. 
 　It will only save up to 10 replays at any one time, and older replays will be overwritten over by newer ones. Please move the replay files that you want to preserve to your own file directory in your computer system. 

  ・Added Friend Invitation function.
 　Press Shift＋Tab to access the Steam Overlay, and you can invite your friends to a match from there.

 ・Network Indicator (aka Antenna) will now be displayed in the search results.

 ・Fixed water rendering for certain graphic boards.
 
 ・Optimized CPU performance for network play. 
 
 ▼Future planned updates 
 ・Keyboard & Mouse configuration.  
 ・Rank Match and Rankings.  
 ・Several graphics option customizations.

notes.title: v1.0.4 Patch (April 27th)
notes.notes:
▼Update log:
・Unlocked the "Holy Knights Fortress" map
・Fixed the rendering for shadows
・Enabled the game to be able to boot up from Steam Offline Mode
　※However, the game will automatically bring the user back to Title menu when the user attempts to connect to Online, while in Offline Mode.
   
▼Planned updates 
・Keyboard & Mouse configuration. 
・Friend invitation. 
・Rank Match and Rankings to be implemented. 
・Allow players to save and watch replays on Replay Viewer. 
・Several graphics option customizations.
 
※Due to technical difficulties, we have delayed the release for "Keyboard & Mouse configuration" as well as "Friend Invitation". We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch (April 19th)
notes.notes:
▼2016/04/19 Patch
 
・Fixed several German and French texts.
・Fixed issue where certain stages display a different picture during stage selection. 
・Optimized CPU usage consumption for network gameplay.
・Adjusted game speed for players who experience slowdowns, either with lack of PC CPU power, or by excessive background programs, so that they do not severely impact the gameplay of other players in network mode.
